nodes.name: tree-store.ts
nodes.summary: Factory module for the reactive file-tree store: lazy directory listing, in-flight request deduplication, and expand/collapse state, reconciling fetched nodes into solid-js stores via immer produce.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SolidJS createStore with immer-style produce() drafts for structural updates of nested tree state; a scope() guard discards responses that arrive after the user switched directories.

nodes.name: createFileTreeStore
nodes.summary: Builds the file-tree store: tracks per-directory loading/error state, deduplicates concurrent listings in an inflight map, and reconciles removed nodes including whole removed subtrees on refresh.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared types for the file-explorer context, including the directory-listing node shape and selected-line range, plus a helper that normalizes a line range into an ordered selection.

nodes.name: selectionFromLines
nodes.summary: Normalizes a possibly reversed line range into an ordered selection clamped so both endpoints are at least 1.

nodes.name: view-cache.ts
nodes.summary: Per-session cache of file-view state (scroll position and selected lines), persisted via Persist.scoped and pruned to a bounded number of files per view.

nodes.name: normalizeSelectedLines
nodes.summary: Orders and clamps a line range so start <= end and both values are positive.

nodes.name: createViewSession
nodes.summary: Creates a persisted per-session view store tracking scroll offsets and selected lines per file, with automatic pruning of stale file entries.

nodes.name: createFileViewCache
nodes.summary: Builds a scoped cache of per-session view stores keyed by directory/session, creating each SolidJS root lazily and disposing entries on eviction or clear.

nodes.name: watcher.ts
nodes.summary: Maps SDK file-change events into file-tree store invalidation: reloads open changed files and refreshes the nearest loaded ancestor directory.

nodes.name: invalidateFromWatcher
nodes.summary: Applies a file-change event through store ops: reloads the file if open, refreshes its directory if loaded, and otherwise walks up parent directories to the nearest loaded one.

nodes.name: global-sdk.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides the global SDK context: creates the opencode client per server and runs a resilient global SSE event stream with heartbeat stall detection, event coalescing, and batched emission to subscribers.
nodes.languageNotes: The SSE loop combines a heartbeat timeout (aborts stalled connections), identity-keyed coalescing of repeated events, and a periodic macrotask yield so high-volume streams do not starve the UI thread.

nodes.name: global-sync.tsx
nodes.summary: Root of the client-side session synchronization engine: wires the global SDK event stream into per-directory child stores, bootstraps projects/providers/agents, loads and trims session lists, and exposes the GlobalSyncProvider context.

nodes.name: loadMcpQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching a directory's MCP server status.

nodes.name: loadLspQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching a directory's LSP server status.

nodes.name: createGlobalSync
nodes.summary: Assembles the global sync engine: global config/provider/path queries, a per-directory SDK cache, the child-store manager, the refresh queue, event listeners dispatching into the reducer, and bounded session loading — the central orchestrator of the sync subsystem.

nodes.name: GlobalSyncProvider
nodes.summary: SolidJS context provider component that instantiates the global sync engine once per app.

nodes.name: useGlobalSync
nodes.summary: Hook returning the global sync context value (projects, sessions, providers, and child-store accessors).

nodes.name: bootstrap.ts
nodes.summary: Bootstrap queries and sequencing for the sync engine: loads global config, projects, providers, agents, and path info, then performs staged per-directory bootstrap and session warming.
nodes.languageNotes: Bootstrap runs in stages gated by requestAnimationFrame (waitForPaint) so heavy initial fetches never block first render; an allSettled-based runAll aggregates failures into a single toast.

nodes.name: waitForPaint
nodes.summary: Returns a promise that resolves after the next animation frame (with a setTimeout fallback), used to yield between bootstrap stages.

nodes.name: showErrors
nodes.summary: Surfaces aggregated bootstrap failures as a single error toast with a formatted server error and an overflow count.

nodes.name: clearProviderRev
nodes.summary: Drops the cached provider revision for a directory, forcing provider data to reload on the next bootstrap.

nodes.name: loadGlobalConfigQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for fetching the global opencode config with retry.

nodes.name: loadProjectsQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for the project list, filtering out test worktrees and sorting deterministically.

nodes.name: bootstrapGlobal
nodes.summary: Runs global bootstrap: fetches config and projects in parallel, seeds the store, shows aggregated errors, and warms recent sessions.

nodes.name: mergeSession
nodes.summary: Merges a single session into the store, inserting or updating it in id order.

nodes.name: warmSessions
nodes.summary: Pre-warms recently updated sessions during bootstrap so their message lists are ready before the user opens them.

nodes.name: loadProvidersQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's provider list.

nodes.name: loadAgentsQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's agent list, normalizing the SDK's flexible agent response shape.

nodes.name: loadPathQuery
nodes.summary: TanStack Query options for a directory's path info.

nodes.name: bootstrapDirectory
nodes.summary: Staged per-directory bootstrap: providers, agents, path, MCP/LSP status, and VCS info are fetched across paint-yielding stages into the directory's child store, with aggregated error reporting.

nodes.name: child-store.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of per-directory child stores: creation under the owner's reactive root, pin/unpin reference tracking, idle-TTL eviction, and per-directory caches for VCS info, project metadata, and icons.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements manual LRU with pin counts plus a WeakMap of owner-scoped pins; eviction disposes SolidJS roots created via createRoot/runWithOwner so reactive graphs are torn down correctly.

nodes.name: createChildStoreManager
nodes.summary: Factory returning the child-store manager API (child, ensureChild, pin/unpin, mark, projectMeta/projectIcon, disposeDirectory) with idle-TTL and max-store eviction driven by pickDirectoriesToEvict.

nodes.name: event-reducer.ts
nodes.summary: Event reducer for the sync engine: folds global SSE events (session/message/part lifecycle, todos, permissions, questions, VCS) into solid-js stores with fine-grained reconcile, plus directory-level event application.

nodes.name: applyGlobalEvent
nodes.summary: Entry point that routes a global event payload to the matching session/message handler and reports whether the store changed.

nodes.name: cleanupSessionCaches
nodes.summary: Drops cached message, part, and todo state for a removed session.

nodes.name: cleanupDroppedSessionCaches
nodes.summary: After a session list reconcile, removes caches and todo state for sessions that disappeared from the trimmed list.

nodes.name: handleSessionCreated
nodes.summary: Inserts a newly created session in id order and re-trims the session list to the configured limit.

nodes.name: handleSessionUpdated
nodes.summary: Applies session.updated events (title, timestamps, parent, revoke) and re-trims the list, keeping child sessions even when over the limit.

nodes.name: handleSessionDeleted
nodes.summary: Removes a deleted session from the store and cascades cache cleanup for it and its child sessions.

nodes.name: handleMessageUpdated
nodes.summary: Upserts a session message summary in the store's message index.

nodes.name: handleMessageRemoved
nodes.summary: Deletes a message and its parts from the session's message cache.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartUpdated
nodes.summary: Reconciles an updated message part (decoding binary payloads) into the part cache.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartRemoved
nodes.summary: Removes a message part and drops the parent message when its last part disappears.

nodes.name: handleMessagePartDelta
nodes.summary: Appends a streaming text delta to a message part, skipping when a stale-delta marker says a full part update already superseded it.

nodes.name: handleVcsBranchUpdated
nodes.summary: Updates the cached VCS branch for a directory on vcs.branch.updated events.

nodes.name: handlePermissionAsked
nodes.summary: Records a pending permission request on its session, initializing the permission queue if needed.

nodes.name: handlePermissionReplied
nodes.summary: Removes a replied permission request from the session's pending list.

nodes.name: handleQuestionAsked
nodes.summary: Records a pending question on its session along with its metadata.

nodes.name: handleQuestionRepliedRejected
nodes.summary: Removes an answered or rejected question from the session's pending list.

nodes.name: applyDirectoryEvent
nodes.summary: Applies directory-scoped events to a child store: config, path, VCS, and permission updates plus session-list refresh triggers, deciding when a refetch or re-bootstrap is needed.
